{%- comment -%}
  llms.txt — https://llmstxt.org

  A Markdown summary of the site for language models and answer engines, at a
  fixed path they are starting to look for. PageSpeed's Agentic Browsing
  category audits it ("llms.txt follows recommendations"), and it was the one
  of that category's four checks that actually applied here: the other three
  are WebMCP, which describes tools a page exposes for an agent to *operate*,
  and this site has no forms to operate — contact is a mailto and a WhatsApp
  link. Annotating tools that do not exist would be an invention.

  GENERATED, like sitemap.xml, and for the same reason. Everything below is
  read from the data the site already renders: the menu from _data/nav.yml, the
  rooms from _data/venues.yml, the classes from _data/schedule.yml, the fee
  from _data/fees.yml. Rename a page and this follows on the next build. Do not
  hand-write facts into it.

  English, and only English. The pages themselves exist in four languages and
  say so; a model asking "where can I train aikido in Barcelona" needs one
  legible answer, not the same answer four times.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign N = site.data.nav -%}
{%- assign V = site.data.venues -%}
{%- assign S = site.data.schedule -%}
{%- assign LO = site.data.locations -%}
{%- assign fee = site.data.fees.prices.monthly.adults.fee -%}
{%- assign kids = site.data.fees.prices.monthly.children.fee -%}
# Aikido Musubi

> A self-managed, non-profit cultural association teaching aikido in the
> Barcelona area since 2008. Four training spaces across Badalona, Sant Adrià
> de Besòs and Barcelona. Aikikai lineage, through Aikido Arashi Group, which
> is recognised by the Aikikai Foundation (Hombu Dojo, Tokyo).

Every page exists in four languages: Spanish at the root, Catalan under `/ca/`,
English under `/en/`, Japanese under `/ja/`. The English URLs are given below.

Judo, iaijutsu and karate are also taught at the Badalona dojo, by their own
instructors. There is no competition in aikido and none is held here.

Adults and young people from the age of 12, with or without previous
experience. {{ fee }} € a month for adults, {{ kids }} € for under-12s.
Registration is free and there are two trial classes. Enrolment is open all
year round.
